use_case: Smart Replies: generative AI feature embedded in the booking product that drafts replies to end-client messages in the subscriber inbox
vendor_or_model: Generative AI model provider API (SYS-04); company-built prompt and feature flag. API terms only; no DPA
data_categories: End-client first names, message text, appointment details, and full free-text service notes (to be cut to the fields a reply needs)
consequential_decision_category: None (messages only; no decision about a person)
human_in_the_loop: Subscriber staff review and send each draft; auto-send for booking confirmations (turned on by 6 of 30 beta subscribers) to be removed
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01: deception for the "never used to train AI" claim; unfairness for data handling); Terms of Service and DPA (use limits; 14-day sub-processor notice)
status: Approved with conditions 2026-09-25 (beta, 30 opt-in subscribers; auto-send off; DPA and notice by 2026-10-31)
